data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 2 x 40HC, Roasted Coffee
data.body:
Dear Maria Jansen,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer for your shipment below.

Shipment details:
- Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
- Equipment: 2 x 40HC
- Commodity: roasted coffee (palletised)

All-in total: EUR 6930

This all-in total covers ocean freight, BAF, terminal handling at Rotterdam and New York, ISPS, documentation and export customs clearance.

Validity: this quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

To proceed with a booking, please reply with your preferred cargo-ready date and shipper and consignee details. We will then confirm space and send you the booking confirmation. If you have any questions about this offer, please let us know.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
